# User-supplied modules

Integrated from the attachments supplied in this conversation:

| Archive | SHA-256 | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| CFNetworkDownload_FTE4ih.zip | `2199dc4302404aff3a254767efc236f1a64ed8dabe930168a426a29ef9211f5d` | Observation module, tests, README |
| CFNetworkDownload_FTE4ih(1).zip | Same as above | Byte-identical duplicate; integrated once |
| CFNetworkDownload_GTK6fx.zip | `65166e4057b4832ae219b2994c7148a3b218045d2f7980425ef06cefd0aae901` | Provider core, registry, router, six adapters |

`SOURCE-HASHES.json` preserves the SHA-256 of each supplied Python source file. Generated bytecode was excluded. The provider upload had no public `__init__.py` and an empty tests directory; the integration adds the public API and tests. The original observation test file and README are preserved here. The original tests are executed through a stdlib unittest adapter in `tests/modular/test_observations.py`.

The working packages at `/ai_providers` and `/observation_layer` are adapted copies. Corrections include immutable sealed observations, filter-before-seal processing, strict replay, trace identity checks, safe failure counters, async tool hooks, structured provider errors, shared bounded HTTP, usage/cache normalization, tool-message round trips, Gemini header authentication, SigV4 corrections, and async methods that need no optional dependency. See `docs/station/MODULAR-LAYERS.md` for compatibility details and remaining capability limits.

The observation schema is explicitly advanced to 1.1.0. No claim is made that the supplied schema 1.0 artifacts had verified integrity. User-uploaded original ZIP files were not modified. The upstream LDD Kit repository is also unchanged.

## Combined 0.3 update

`CFNetworkDownload_Ioxz7q.zip` (SHA-256 `51006c743ef6d7eb529733486f6c329aac2b998842efde54631e81863258523f`) contributes the goal, verifier, brakes, quarantine, loop, integration wrapper, public exports and 32 tests. Other source files match the 0.2 base and were not allowed to overwrite the newer modular integration. The uploaded `BUNDLE.json`, checksums and Git history still describe the old build; this release regenerates those artifacts from the combined committed tree.

Corrections to the new layer enforce actual pass/budget limits, abort priority, immutable goal/action values, complete goal hashes, amendment limits and lineage, closed result types, fail-closed policy evaluation, store-bound holds, and once-only execution. Provider errors remain errors. Quarantine and LoopController are connected to live station model calls and mission dependency waves. The supplied control tests remain intact; regression tests are in `tests/test_control_integrity.py`.
